# HELLO OS

> HELLO OS is a local-first agentic OS prototype with agent identity, persistent memory, missions, an MCP-compatible tool service, A2A-style tasks, and a human dashboard.

## Canonical sources
- Repository: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/Hello-OS
- Project guide: https://codesbyfebin.github.io/Hello-OS/
- Agent guide: https://codesbyfebin.github.io/Hello-OS/agent-guide/
- AML Studio guide: https://codesbyfebin.github.io/Hello-OS/aml-studio/
- Local AML Studio route: http://localhost:3000/aml-studio (available when the app is running)
- Installation guide: https://codesbyfebin.github.io/Hello-OS/getting-started/
- Downloads: https://codesbyfebin.github.io/Hello-OS/downloads/
- Full feature and security notes: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/Hello-OS/blob/main/README.md
- Agent contributor instructions: https://github.com/CodesbyFebin/Hello-OS/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Verified implementation facts
- Next.js, React, TypeScript, Prisma, and SQLite are used by the app.
- Docker Compose runs the dashboard and separate MCP service.
- Identity creation uses Ed25519 and did:key.
- MCP tool endpoint: /mcp; selected tools include forge, cortex, tiered memory, and checkpoint.
- Agent card: /.well-known/agent-card.json.
- A2A-style JSON-RPC includes message/send and tasks/get, tasks/list, tasks/update, tasks/cancel.
- Private signing keys are stored by the demo server; this is not production key custody.
- APK, EXE/PEXE, and DEB packages are not currently published.
- GitHub Pages hosts static documentation only; it does not run the dynamic app, APIs, SQLite, or MCP.

## Start locally
Clone the repository and run `docker compose up --build`; open http://localhost:3000. See README for prerequisites and data handling.

## Limits
This is an experimental prototype. It does not claim full MCP/A2A conformance, OAuth, SSE, production multi-tenancy, tamper-proof auditing, real payments, or Firecracker microVM checkpoints. No crawler ping guarantees search indexing or ranking.

## Vision claims not verified as implemented
A broader concept brief mentions hello.id, hello.cortex, hello.ledger, hello.mesh, hello.forge, hello.cloud, and hello.nexus. Treat these as vision labels, not deployed services. USDC, paid marketplace/escrow, verifiable credentials, lineage chains, temporal graph and sleep-cycle memory, Firecracker execution, database forks, swarms, governance, and evolutionary tournaments are not shipped by this codebase. The brief's performance figures, agent counts, case studies, release checksums, external URLs, and claimed license are unverified and must not be repeated as facts. No native APK, EXE/PEXE, DEB, AppImage, DMG, IPA, AAB, standalone binary, or SDK archive is published. The repository currently has no LICENSE file.
